local_review.finding_body:
The exact review finalization command repeatedly exits 1 with `Review finalization changed the publishable tree` after every substantive gate passes. `publishable_tree_digest()` hashes raw `git diff --binary HEAD --` output. During `generateLibraryStats`, Git's adaptive object abbreviation grows, changing only the diff header from `index e80d11edc3..92d6c8b6b5` (1918 bytes) to `index e80d11edc34..92d6c8b6b57` (1920 bytes); the patch body and worktree content are unchanged. Because the fix belongs in shared `forge/git_scripts/review_finalization.py`, FS-contribution-contract.5.3 requires escalation rather than a contribution-local repair.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/10242 (#10242)
local_review.finding_title: Review finalization hashes unstable abbreviated Git object IDs
local_review.fix_note: In the target test, replaced the removed `getIdleTimestamp()` check with before/after `getIdleFor()` assertions and raised asynchronous endpoint waits from 2 to 10 seconds to preserve compile-fix coverage and satisfy the explicit I/O-timeout floor.
local_review.review_comment:
The contribution is correctly scoped, the old and new dynamic-access reports both pass at 0/0, and repeated finalization runs passed all three test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test screening, and statistics generation. I repaired the assertion-removal and short I/O-wait violations, but the required stable finalization cannot complete because its publishable-tree digest changes on a content-identical Git diff. This is a shared Forge finalization defect under FS-contribution-contract.5.3, so maintainer intervention is required.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/10242 (#10242)
